name: TRIS Directive
impact_assessment: codification of Directive 98/34/EC; no impact assessment of its own
evidence_rating: thin: Commission operation reports count notifications and reactions; no independent study of the effect on trade barriers
summary: Member States must notify draft technical rules and online-service rules before adopting them. In 2016-2020 the Commission received 3,553 notifications and issued 212 detailed opinions and 816 comments; it considers the procedure effective at preventing barriers, but this rests on activity counts, not on a measure of barriers avoided.

indicators.objective: No monitoring indicators set in the proposal; assessed through the Commission's reports listed below

indicators.evidence: 2016-2020: 3,553 notifications; 212 detailed opinions and 816 comments by the Commission; access to notifications rose from about 1.2 million (2015) to 7.4 million (2020).

literature.citation: European Commission (2022), Report on the operation of the Single Market Transparency Directive from 2016 to 2020, COM(2022) 481 (with SWD(2022) 297)
literature.title: Report on the operation of the Single Market Transparency Directive from 2016 to 2020
literature.headline: 3,553 notifications in 2016-2020; 212 detailed opinions and 816 comments; procedure judged effective in preventing technical barriers and useful during COVID-19
literature.summary_plain: The Commission reports that the notification procedure keeps working and helps stop new national barriers, based on counts of notifications and its own reactions.
